proposal.title: Standardize Artemis storage from NCC 1982 and correct Accounts cartridge
proposal.reason: From event.ncc82_graphics_mouse on 7 June 1982, every retained Artemis/Artemis PRO computer has one FDD and one MiniScribe 4010 HDD, including every host in multi-computer bundles. Preserve all pre-NCC compositions, adding contiguous new revisions where needed; Office Professional already begins at this event. Correct Artemis Accounts revision 2 from the server cartridge to standard AIONix and carry that correction into its new storage revision. Complete-record changes are grouped to avoid overlapping approvals.

before.title: NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
before.description: Open the NCC presentation in Houston on 7 June and run demonstrations through 10 June. Introduce the colour upgrade and mouse through business reports, hands-on tutorials and Entertainment Suite demonstrations. Show supported CP/M and AIONix pointing updates, explain the update path for older applications, and invite visitors to dealer demonstrations and developer sessions.

inputs.description: The press preview supplies the rehearsed public presentation and briefing materials.
Use qualified demonstration configurations and tested software builds; explain application-specific update requirements and record any remaining delivery conditions.

outcomes.description: Public demonstrations and visitor enquiries establish the basis for the scheduled developer sessions and dealer follow-up.

after.title: NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
after.description: Open the NCC presentation in Houston on 7 June and run demonstrations through 10 June. Introduce the colour upgrade and mouse through business reports, hands-on tutorials and Entertainment Suite demonstrations. Show supported CP/M and AIONix pointing updates, explain the update path for older applications, and invite visitors to dealer demonstrations and developer sessions.

inputs.description: The press preview supplies the rehearsed public presentation and briefing materials.
Use qualified demonstration configurations and tested software builds; explain application-specific update requirements and record any remaining delivery conditions.

outcomes.description: Public demonstrations and visitor enquiries establish the basis for the scheduled developer sessions and dealer follow-up.

From this NCC introduction, Artemis and Artemis PRO configurations, including Office Professional and each computer in multi-machine packages, specify one floppy drive and one MiniScribe 4010 hard disk per computer. Earlier compositions remain unchanged; controller, formatted-capacity and complete-system qualification remain required.

assembly_requirements.description: Run the agreed release-quality native AutoCAD build on the reference configuration
Load/save and exchange a representative drawing; verify numerical geometry
Use both displays and the mouse with correct focus and cursor restoration
Show readable antialiased lines and stable display refresh under accelerator load
Plot a physical drawing and verify scale and geometry
Recover from interrupted work and restore a backup
Document supported features; no automatic later-version dimensioning, object-snap or 3D claims

before.title: NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
before.description: Open the NCC presentation in Houston on 7 June and run demonstrations through 10 June. Introduce the colour upgrade and mouse through business reports, hands-on tutorials and Entertainment Suite demonstrations. Show supported CP/M and AIONix pointing updates, explain the update path for older applications, and invite visitors to dealer demonstrations and developer sessions.

inputs.description: The press preview supplies the rehearsed public presentation and briefing materials.
Use qualified demonstration configurations and tested software builds; explain application-specific update requirements and record any remaining delivery conditions.

outcomes.description: Public demonstrations and visitor enquiries establish the basis for the scheduled developer sessions and dealer follow-up.

From this NCC introduction, Artemis and Artemis PRO configurations, including Office Professional and each computer in multi-machine packages, specify one floppy drive and one MiniScribe 4010 hard disk per computer. Earlier compositions remain unchanged; controller, formatted-capacity and complete-system qualification remain required.
